property_summary: For any target address and value, calling sendMoney(...) on the correct contract either forwards funds or reverts on call failure (so the call does not silently fail); the mutant that removes the require can silently ignore a failing low-level call, so there exist inputs (a failing callee and a nonzero value) where the reference reverts but the mutant returns successfully, changing post-call observable state.
change_summary: Replace the require on the low-level call result with an unconditional ignore so failed calls no longer revert (removes require), changing post-call state visibility when sendMoney fails.
